text_block_list.text:
Today is the February Stakes, the first of
the
races Смарт Фалкон declared she'd
win. A sense of
excitement fills the air at
Tokyo Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I wonder how Смарт Фалкон's gonna do.
What if
she stumbles right off the bat?
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Hm... She was pretty good last year, but
I
wouldn't say she's the best.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
You know, I think this is my first time
watching a
dirt race. I'm actually getting
pretty hyped up.
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон can feel the energy of the
venue
even from the waiting room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...I wonder how high we can go?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Well, Tokyo Racecourse is also home to
the
Japanese Derby, right?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is a high-profile turf
race
exclusive to classic-year racers,
many of whom
stake their dreams on it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Derby is on the same level as the
Arima
Kinen... or bigger, even.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering how close we can
get to that.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: It's a high hurdle, for sure.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the Derby is a super special
race—I know
that! No matter how hard I
chase it, I can't get
there right now.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Still, we're getting plenty of attention!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If I can place first today, the next race
will get
just a little more special!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: And you'll have to keep on winning.

text_block_list.text:
I know. We won't have a story if I go
losing right
at the start.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I have to win and become the trending
topic. That
way, I'll be all smiles on the
year-end stage!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...All right! Time to kick things off on the
right
foot!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
